---
name: accessibility-inclusive-ui
description: Audit and improve semantic HTML, keyboard support, focus management, contrast, and inclusive interaction.
---
# Accessibility
- Prefer semantic HTML and native controls; use ARIA only when needed.
- Label every input and associate validation messages with controls.
- Support keyboard navigation, visible focus, logical tab order, Escape in dialogs, and focus restoration.
- Use meaningful headings, landmarks, accessible names, and informative image alt text.
- Announce important state changes without announcing every incoming chat message.
- Check contrast in both themes, 200% zoom, reflow, and reduced-motion preferences.
- Do not claim WCAG conformance without a documented audit.
